$comment: Business tools and the step-by-step path of the Trabalho tab (ADR 0194, bipe-chat/bipe#798). Stable IDs. needs: a real dependency; catalog_service and catalog_product mean at least one active catálogo item of that kind. A tool with no needs is never blocked. steps: the done rule is computed by bipe-api from records. sectors: step_order is the order the sector sets, first_tool the first tool the tab suggests, agenda_template an ID of agenda-templates.json (or absent). A sector never limits the tools (ADR 0194 point 9). generic: the path of an account with no sector. suggestions: rules on records only, never on chats (ADR 0194 points 14 to 16). resale: the sector that shows Selos de revenda in the tab (ADR 0194 point 19).

steps.rule: the account has a handle and the owner opened the link or QR code screen
at least catalogMinItems active catálogo items
at least one tool is live
a verified CNPJ claim; an autônomo with no CNPJ does not get this step (ADR 0138)
the account has a second person, or the Responsável chose Só eu atendo

suggestions.rule: an active catálogo item with the price on request, and the tool is off
an active catálogo service, and the tool is off
an active catálogo product with a fixed amount, and the tool is off
